# Sample addon rules

House rules for code in a sample addon. They are house rules, not general
Python advice.

Guidelines are grouped by domain, one file per domain in `references/`, one
section per domain below:

- `references/manifest.md` — manifest keys and the version number scheme.

## Manifest

Declare every addon in the manifest and keep the version number monotonic.
The full rules live in `references/manifest.md`.
